name: Deep Implicit Network (DIN) Regularizer
definition: A mesh-based training regularization for Deep Implicit Networks (DINs) to ensure the Distance Field (DF) produced by the DIN agrees with the resulting extracted mesh. It minimizes the discrepancy between the predicted DF and the distance from grid nodes to the mesh extracted via SDC.
summary: The Deep Implicit Network Regularizer is a self-supervised mesh-based training objective that improves surface fidelity by minimizing the discrepancy between the predicted field and distances to an extracted mesh, rather than relying on ground-truth SDF values.
